meta.name: accessibility-aggregation
meta.description: Build comprehensive chromatin accessibility maps by aggregating ATAC-seq and DNase-seq narrowPeak data across multiple ENCODE experiments, donors, and labs. Use when the user wants to answer "where is chromatin accessible in my tissue?" by combining peak calls into a union peak set. Handles cross-lab variation, ATAC vs DNase platform differences, and ENCODE blocklist filtering.

copy.tagline: 聚合ENCODE实验数据构建染色质可及性图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在特定组织中整合多个实验的染色质可及性数据。
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate ENCODE experiments to build chromatin accessibility maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate chromatin accessibility data from multiple ENCODE experiments for a specific tissue.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 该技能会搜索并下载多个ENCODE实验的ATAC-seq和DNase-seq峰文件，过滤黑名单和低信号峰，合并所有峰为一个联合开放染色质区域集，并标注每个区域在多少样本中出现。
howto.when: 当用户询问“我的组织中染色质在哪里开放？”或要求“构建开放染色质图谱”时触发。也适用于需要合并不同实验室、供体或平台（ATAC vs DNase）的开放染色质数据。

say.text: 帮我汇总胰腺的ATAC-seq峰数据。
say.note: 技能会搜索胰腺ATAC-seq实验并开始聚合流程。

say.text: 合并所有供体的DNase-seq开放染色质区域。
say.note: 技能会下载并合并多个DNase-seq样本的峰。

say.text: 构建大脑皮层的联合开放染色质图谱。

howto.what_en: This skill searches and downloads ATAC-seq and DNase-seq peak files from multiple ENCODE experiments, filters blacklisted regions and low-signal peaks, merges all peaks into a union set of open chromatin regions, and annotates each region with the number of samples supporting it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks "where is chromatin accessible in my tissue?" or requests to "build an open chromatin map." Also applicable when merging accessibility data from different labs, donors, or platforms (ATAC vs DNase).

say_en.note: Skill searches pancreas ATAC-seq experiments and starts aggregation.

say_en.text: Combine DNase-seq open chromatin across donors.
say_en.note: Skill downloads and merges peaks from multiple DNase-seq samples.

say_en.text: Build a union open chromatin map for brain cortex.
say_en.note: Skill integrates ATAC-seq and DNase-seq data into a union peak set.
